title: Secure the Zone
description:
"Claim ground, hold fast."

Throughout the battle, both sides contest key areas of the warzone. Whoever can consistently secure ground will dictate the flow of the fight.
setup: Place 3 Objective markers along the centerline of the battlefield, each at least 6 Paces apart.
victory: At the end of each Turn, score 1 MP per Objective your Squad controls (has more Units Adjacent than the enemy).
special: If a Squad controls all 3 Objectives at the end of any Turn, they gain +1 MP immediately (once per game).

rewards.name: Field Stabilizers
rewards.effect: One Unit gains +1 ARM during Turn 1 of its next mission (representing improved defensive position setup).

rewards.name: Forward Command
rewards.effect: +1 TO during any Turn in the next mission.

title: Hold the Line
description:
"The enemy breaks upon our wall."

Victory favors the steadfast. The longer you hold, the stronger your claim.
setup: Each Squad places 1 Objective fully within their own half of the Battlefield, at least 8 Paces from any edge.
victory: At the end of Turn 4, score 2 MP per Objective controlled by your Squad. If both Squads control their own Objectives, the mission is a Draw.
special: Units in cover adjacent to an Objective gain +1 ARM against ranged attacks.

rewards.name: Tactical Resupply
rewards.effect: One Unit gains auto-cover in the next mission (treated as Cover status against Ranged Attacks).

rewards.name: Healed Injury
rewards.effect: One Unit may immediately remove one non-Deceased Injury.

title: Power Cycle
description:
"Reactivate the grid before the enemy shuts it down."

A dormant facility flickers to life. Reactors surge, systems fail, and both sides fight to keep control of unstable nodes.
setup: Place 3 Power Nodes along the centerline. Each starts Inactive.
victory: At the end of each Turn, score 1 MP per Active Node you control.
special: A Unit within 1 Pace of a Node may take a Mission Action (Toggle, 1 ACT) to flip it Active/Inactive. Active Nodes emit dangerous radiation: Units within 1 Pace suffer 1 HIT (ignores ARM) on a roll of 5+ at the end of the Turn.

rewards.name: Voltage Spikes
rewards.effect: One unit's weapon gains RLT (Relentless) or RND1 (Rending 1) in the next mission.

rewards.name: Technician Assist
rewards.effect: One Unit gains Technician 1 (perform one Mission action for 1 less ACT) for the next mission.

title: Sabotage
description:
"They built it. You break it."

A vital structure powers the enemy advance. One force must destroy it; the other, defend it at all costs.
setup: Defender places 2 Objective structures fully within their Deployment Zone.
deployment: Attacker deploys second, on the opposite edge.
victory: At the end of Turn 4, the Attacker scores 3 MP for each destroyed structure. Defender scores 3 MP for each remaining intact.
special: A Unit within 1 Pace of a structure may take a Mission Action (Plant Charges, 2 ACT). At the start of the next Turn, roll a D6; on 4+, the structure is destroyed.

rewards.name: Demo Expert
rewards.effect: One Unit gains "Demo charge" (A free Grenade action) for the next mission.

rewards.name: Quick Prep
rewards.effect: One Unit gains +1 ACT in Turn 1 of the next mission.

title: Push the Line
description:
"Drive them back step by step."

Advance across the battlefield and seize ground from the enemy.
setup: Place 3 Objectives: one centered on each player’s Deployment edge and one at the exact center.
victory: At the end of each Turn, score 1 MP if you control your own Objective, 2 MP if you control the center, and 3 MP if you control the enemy’s.
special: If you control the enemy Objective at the end of Turn 3 or earlier, gain an additional +1 MP bonus (once per game).

rewards.name: Aggressive Push
rewards.effect: One Unit gains +1 ACT (Action Point) in Turn 1 of the next mission.

rewards.name: Rapid Deployment
rewards.effect: One Unit may perform a free move after its deployment. If the next mission deploys Units before Turn 1, perform this move after all Units have been deployed, before Turn 1.

title: Centerpoint
description:
"All roads lead to ruin."

The battle converges on a single decisive location.
setup: Place 1 Objective at the exact center of the Battlefield.
victory: At the end of Turn 4, the Squad controlling the central Objective scores 6 MP.
special: Units Adjacent to the Objective may not Evade or go Hidden. It’s too exposed.

rewards.name: Decisive Strike
rewards.effect: One Unit gets one Spoil of War in the next mission (remove at the end of the mission).

rewards.name: Weapon Calibration
rewards.effect: One unit's weapon gains RLT or RND1 in the next mission.

title: Recover Intel
description:
"Retrieve the data before the uplink burns."

Valuable intel lies scattered among the ruins.
setup: Place 3 Data Cores along the centerline.
victory: At the end of Turn 4, score 2 MP per Data Core carried by your Units.
special: A Unit within 1 Pace may take a Mission Action (Collect, 1 ACT) to claim a Data Core. Units may carry one Core each. If the carrier is Taken Out, the Core drops on its tile.

rewards.name: Intelligence Priority
rewards.effect: Start the next mission with +1 TO and may re-roll TOs once during the next mission.

rewards.name: Treasure Trove
rewards.effect: The Squad may spend an additional 5GP on gear for the next mission.

title: Ambush
description:
"Intercept the courier before they vanish into the wasteland."

One side must extract a critical asset; the other must stop them.
setup: Defender selects one Unit as the Courier, carrying a Data Core.
deployment: Courier starts deployed; the Attacker deploys second.
victory: If the Courier survives to Turn 4, Defender scores 6 MP. If the Courier is Taken Out, Attacker scores 6 MP.
special: When the Courier is Taken Out, place the Core on that tile. It can be recovered and carried off by any Unit.

rewards.name: Disruption Scan
rewards.effect: One Unit gains +1 MSK (Melee Skill) or +1 RSK (Ranged Skill) for the next mission.

rewards.name: Targeted Strike
rewards.effect: The enemy Leader gains -1 ARM (minimum 1) for the next mission.

title: Breakout
description:
"Cut them off before they breach the perimeter."

The enemy carries stolen intel and must escape the field.
setup: Defender selects a Courier carrying one Core.
deployment: Courier deploys within their Deployment Zone.
victory: If the Courier exits the Attacker’s battlefield edge carrying the Core, Defender scores 6 MP immediately. Otherwise, Attacker scores 6 MP if the Courier is Taken Out before extraction.
special: Courier gains +1 MSK but cannot Attack.

rewards.name: Extraction Specialist
rewards.effect: One Unit may use the MedPack skill (recover 1D3 lost HIT) once in the next mission.

rewards.name: Cloaked Movement
rewards.effect: One Unit cannot be targeted in ranged combat in Turn 1 of the next mission.

title: Relay Run
description:
"Grab the beacon and get it home."

A beacon must be secured and relayed back to command.
setup: Place one Beacon Objective at the Battlefield center.
victory: A Squad scores 6 MP if any Unit exits their own Battlefield edge carrying the Beacon.
special: A Unit within 1 Pace may take a Mission Action (Collect, 1 ACT) to claim the Beacon. Carriers lose -1 ACT while holding it.

rewards.name: TO Optimization
rewards.effect: During the next mission, the Squad may re-roll TOs once.

rewards.name: Swift Runner
rewards.effect: One Unit gains Swift (first Dash action costs 0 ACT) in the next mission.

title: Search and Recover
description:
"Something’s buried here. Find it before they do."

You don’t know where it is—but the longer you search, the better your odds.
setup: Place 3 Search Zones along the centerline.
victory: Once a Squad finds the objective, they score 1 MP each Turn they control it.
special: A Unit within a Search Zone may take a Mission Action (Search, 1 ACT). Roll a D6; success on 6+ (Turn 1), 5+ (Turn 2), 4+ (Turn 3+). The first success reveals the hidden Objective in that Zone.

rewards.name: Ancient Artifact
rewards.effect: One Spoil of War (SoW) immediately.

rewards.name: Preemptive Strike
rewards.effect: One Unit gains +1 HIT in the next mission.

title: Commitment Protocol
description:
"Power must build before the final strike."

Energy charges build throughout the fight until a decisive moment of release.
setup: Place 1 Reactor Objective at the center of the field.
victory: At the end of Turn 4, the Squad that committed the most Energy Tokens scores 6 MP.
special: A Unit within 1 Pace may take a Mission Action (Charge, 1 ACT) to add 1 Energy Token to its Squad’s pool. On Turn 4, a Unit within 1 Pace may take a Mission Action (Commit, 1 ACT) to add all stored Tokens to the Reactor. Tokens remain if the carrier is Taken Out.

rewards.name: Energy Overflow
rewards.effect: One Unit gains +1 ACT in any one Turn (announce when activating).

rewards.name: Tactical Reversal
rewards.effect: Once in the next mission, any Unit may spend 1 ACT to add 1 TO to the Squad's TOs.

title: Attrition
description:
"No prisoners."

Your orders are simple: outkill the enemy.
victory: At the end of each Turn, if you have Taken Out more enemy Units than they have Taken Out of yours, score 2 MP.

rewards.name: Aggressive Momentum
rewards.effect: During the next mission, one unit gains +1 MSK or +1 RSK the first time it performs combat.

rewards.name: Reinforced Armor
rewards.effect: One Unit gains +1 ARM (Armor) for the next mission.

title: Last Stand
description:
"Stand your ground until nothing moves."

The battle grinds to dust. Only the unbroken remain.
victory: At the end of Turn 4, total the (ACT + HIT) of all surviving Units in each Squad. The higher total scores 6 MP.
special: If both totals are equal, the battle is declared a Draw.

rewards.name: Veteran Status
rewards.effect: One Unit gains +1 MSK (Melee Skill) permanently.

rewards.name: Urgent Treatment
rewards.effect: One Unit may immediately heal one of its Injuries.

title: Assassinate
description:
"Cut off the head, the body dies."

Hunt down the enemy commander.
setup: Each Squad nominates one Leader Unit.
victory: If the enemy Leader is Taken Out, your Squad scores 6 MP immediately.
special: Leaders gain +1 ACT but cannot Hide or Deploy Hidden.

rewards.name: Intel Leak
rewards.effect: In the next mission, enemy Leader gains -1 ARM (minimum 1).

rewards.name: Strategize Bonus
rewards.effect: Squad gains the ability to use Strategize (1ACT) (gain +1 TO) once per mission in the next mission.

title: Rivals
description:
"Settle the score."

Two units meet on the battlefield, bound by vengeance or destiny.
setup: Each Squad secretly selects one Rival Unit (not the Leader). Reveal simultaneously after deployment.
victory: If your Rival Takes Out the enemy Rival, score 6 MP. If both Rivals are still alive at game’s end, no one scores.
special: Rivals gain +1 HIT and +1 to Attack rolls against each other.

rewards.name: Personal Vendetta
rewards.effect: In the next mission, select one enemy unit and gains +1 SKL (Ranged or Melee Skill) when targeting that enemy.

rewards.name: Defensive Stance
rewards.effect: One Unit gains Tough 1 (re-roll 1 Melee Save die) in the next mission.

title: Encroach
description:
"Push deep and hold the line."

Dominate enemy territory with strength of arms.
victory: At the end of Turn 4, total (ACT + HIT) of Units standing on the enemy’s half. Higher total scores 6 MP.
special: Units Adjacent to enemies do not count toward scoring.

rewards.name: Overwhelming Presence
rewards.effect: Instead of rolling TOs, get 4 TOs in any one turn in the next mission.

rewards.name: Deep Strike
rewards.effect: One Unit may perform a free move after its deployment. If the next mission deploys Units before Turn 1, perform this move after all Units have been deployed.

title: Evac Point
description:
"Rendezvous or die trying."

The dropship waits only moments—reach it before the storm consumes the battlefield.
setup: The Central Tile of the battlefield is the Evac Zone.
victory: At the end of Turn 4, total (ACT + HIT) of Units in the Evac Zone not Adjacent to enemies. Higher total scores 6 MP.
special: Units may take a Mission Action (Extract, 2 ACT) if within the Evac Zone and unengaged; extracted Units are removed and count as double their (ACT + HIT) for scoring.

rewards.name: Extraction Gear
rewards.effect: One Unit gains Jump Pack (ignore vertical distance when climbing) in the next mission.

rewards.name: Resourceful Salvage
rewards.effect: Unit gains Resourceful (1 XP) immediately (this is a persistent benefit).
